stage.title: The things we left behind
stage.speaker: Survey crew
stage.motivation: Before the drive failed we left a small furniture sled beside the route. We remember the way. Bring it back; it has our table and the pictures that made this camp ours.

area.label: The things we left behind
area.travelText: We gather the known equipment for this nearby work. The larger expedition remains at its current camp or depot.

caches.label: Known expedition equipment
caches.narrative: The crew identifies its own tagged sled on a nearby known shoulder. Only ordinary recovery padding and their personal picture roll are new loose pieces; the crate unfolds into its original mess table.

stage.title: Something for the next crew
stage.speaker: Survey crew
stage.motivation: The potatoes fed us. The little tray we saved on landing is still alive too. Make a nursery bay for it: this camp can be more than something we survived.

area.label: Something for the next crew
area.travelText: We gather the known equipment for this nearby work. The larger expedition remains at its current camp or depot.

caches.label: Known expedition equipment
caches.narrative: A single greenhouse cultivation kit holds the printed grid, original diffuser fitting, soft support lattice and labels. We reuse the landing’s living tray rather than granting another crop.

stage.title: Not every ripple is a river
stage.speaker: Survey crew
stage.motivation: The new core supports our basin story, but a nearby ripple pattern looks suspiciously familiar. Compare the two exposures before we tell Earth they mean the same thing.

area.label: Not every ripple is a river
area.travelText: We gather the known equipment for this nearby work. The larger expedition remains at its current camp or depot.

caches.label: Known expedition equipment
caches.narrative: The existing geology team’s single comparison kit holds a board, two-cell case, dry impression sheet and document sleeve. The loose chip is explicitly from the adjacent gravel ledge, not supplied as a laboratory conclusion.

objectives.text: Keep the two differently sourced specimens distinct.

stage.title: The tracks that were not ours
stage.speaker: Survey crew
stage.motivation: The depot should be along the old service route, but the dark tracks have changed. Find the permanent markers. Our protected spare controller matches the depot cargo hauler—we can use that to bring the samples to the ship.

area.label: The tracks that were not ours
area.travelText: We gather the known equipment for this nearby work. The larger expedition remains at its current camp or depot.

caches.label: Known expedition equipment
caches.narrative: One existing depot navigation-and-maintenance locker holds its original survey print, cleaning pad and folding sign. The stored standardized cargo hauler and platform stand beside it. Their compatible controller specification is legible before installation.
